events.description: A special 11/11/11 edition of HF News featuring an exclusive video interview with Omniscient and trivia about the rare 11/11/11 date (last occurrence in 1911 brought the 'Great Blue Norther' storm; also marks Veterans Day and Remembrance Day).
Exclusive video interview with Omniscient, published as a special 11/11/11 edition of HF News.
